notes: «وَ عَنْهُ بِإِسْنَادِهِ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيِّ»: «عنه» is Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. al-Walid of prev1; the names taken over from prev1 are those up to al-Barqi, and the text writes «البرقي» itself.
Prev1's names after al-Barqi are not taken over, since this report starts a new chain at «بعض أصحابنا».
